dial.summary: Four of eight indicators remain supportive on November 20 — Global M2 flat near $104T, ISM Manufacturing holding at 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion), Fed balance sheet updated to $6.74T per latest H.4.1, and near-zero BTC funding (0.0047%) confirm a fully deleveraged market; BTC pulled to a four-month low near $63.7K as DXY holds at 103.94 (dominant headwind), but stablecoin dominance easing to 12.8% with total crypto edging up to $2.22T signals sidelined capital beginning to redeploy ahead of the critical November 25 PCE print.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: September 2026 G4 M2 at $104.3T per MacroMicro; StreetStats 4-economy basket at $103,884B ($103.9T) as of Nov 19–20; October G4 data not yet published; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%), trend UP; status supportive (4-week trend up, no YoY contraction); held unchanged pending October G4 publication mid-to-late November.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2), above consensus 54.7%, up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next release December 1, 2026 (November data).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY closed at 103.945 on November 19, 2026 per CNBC (52-week high 103.97 on Nov 19); Trading Economics showed 103.65 intraday; Investing.com Nov 18 close: 103.90; using 103.94 as latest close; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 20 to 103.94, net +2.2 points, well above 0.5% flat threshold; hawkish Fed tone driving the move; status headwind (above 100 threshold — must fall below 97.5 for supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: DFII10 at 2.90% as of November 19, 2026 (tipsyield.com; Macrotrends showed 2.92% on Nov 16, FRED/ALFRED latest entry 2.63% as of Nov 6 — secondary aggregators more current); 4-week change Oct 20 (~2.85–2.90%) to Nov 19 (2.90%) = 0–5bps, within flat threshold; status neutral (above 2% but flat trend — headwind requires both rising trend AND above 2%).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread at 29bps as of November 17, 2026 per SOFR rate (10Y 5.12%, 2Y 4.83%); recessionpulse.com shows Nov 10 at +25bps, Nov 6 at +35bps; 4-week change essentially flat vs ~+28–32bps on October 20; status neutral (positive spread, curve not inverted — headwind requires < -50bps).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 release (down $17.4B from prior week's $6,758,867M); 4-week change Oct 22 (~$6.755T) → Nov 18 ($6.741T) = -$14B = -0.2%, within flat threshold; status supportive (minimal weekly decline, QT effectively ended, YoY still up ~$161B).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Coinglass OI-weighted BTC funding rate at 0.0047% per 8h as of November 19, 2026 (CoinGlass BTC page; a separate futures page showed 0.0065%; negative on Binance/OKX/Bybit on November 13 before recovering); 30-day trend FLAT — near zero throughout October–November with brief negative dip November 13; status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold, classic deleveraged accumulation signal).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap $283.137B (DefiLlama Nov 19); total crypto $2.22T (CoinGecko Nov 19–20, BTC dominance 56.04%); derived stablecoin dominance 12.8%, easing from 13.2% on Nov 19 as total crypto edged higher; 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 21 to 12.8%; BTC at ~$63.7K (four-month low per Fortune/crypto.news); status neutral (dominance rising 30-day but TOTAL crypto mixed — headwind requires rising stables AND rising TOTAL simultaneously).

upcoming.title: S&P Global Flash PMIs (November 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases flash estimates for US Manufacturing and Services PMIs for November 2026 at 9:45 AM ET; first real-time read on November business activity ahead of the December 1 ISM Manufacturing PMI; a Services print above 55 would reinforce the sticky-inflation narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC decision; Euro area flash PMIs also released same morning.

upcoming.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Conference Board releases November 2026 Consumer Confidence Index at 10:00 AM ET (last Tuesday of month); tracks current conditions and 6-month expectations; a deterioration from October's level would signal cracks in the consumer spending backdrop ahead of the November 25 PCE release.

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 — Second Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP second estimate at 8:30 AM ET on the compressed Wednesday pre-Thanksgiving schedule (Nov 26 Thanksgiving); watch consumer spending and PCE deflator revisions for any upside that would reinforce the December 9 FOMC hike case; released same day as October PCE on thin pre-holiday liquidity.

upcoming.title: PCE Inflation / Personal Income (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases October 2026 Personal Income and Outlays at 8:30 AM ET; PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge — a hot core reading above +0.3% MoM would seal the December 9 FOMC hike after October CPI surprised at +0.4% MoM; this is the last major inflation print before the November 29 FOMC blackout period starts.
